title: Shrubs for Kansas Landscapes

The text discusses the purpose and aesthetic benefits of different shrub varieties, emphasizing their roles in enhancing the visual appeal and functionality of outdoor spaces. The book is structured around a detailed exploration of shrub types categorized by characteristics such as height, spread, and adaptability to the Kansas environment.
